caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with tender chashu and dark nori resting atop. The bowl’s red-trimmed rim frames the steaming dish, set against a warm, softly lit background with a white spoon poised for the first bite.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle natural texture under soft lighting.
The chashu pork is a round, pinkish-brown slice with visible marbling and green herb flecks on its surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, glossy, rectangular, with a slightly uneven, textured surface and visible brownish edges.
The miso broth is orange-brown, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and green onions with visible oil sheen.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly curved, textured strips with visible fibrous surface details.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue characters, glossy rim, smooth surface.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
